results.heading: What is the No Claim Discount (NCD) Protector? How does it work?
results.snippet: The NCD protector is an optional benefit and applies only to policyholders of 50% NCD at an additional premium. It will protect your NCD in the event of a first claim during your policy period. If a second claim is made, the normal NCD rules apply and your NCD will be reduced to 20% on your next policy renewal. The protected NCD is not transferable to another insurer. You will need to renew your policy with HDFC Assurance in order to enjoy this benefit.

results.heading: Section 10. Emergency Medical Transportation
results.snippet: We will reimburse You up to the Benefit Limit for Ambulance charges incurred to transport You to a Hospital up to $200 per Injury.

results.heading: Section 17. Emergency Phone Charges
results.snippet:
We shall pay up to the Benefit Limit of the telephone charges incurred on Your personal mobile phone used for the sole purpose of engaging the services of Our appointed assistance company during a medical emergency and for which a medical claim has been submitted under Section 1.

The telephone charges incurred must be supported by an itemized bill from Your telecommunication company.

results.heading: Scale of Compensation · §3
results.snippet:
- Loss by physical severance or Permanent Disablement of great toe two phalanges: 5% compensation of the Benefit Limit
- Loss by physical severance or Permanent Disablement of great toe one phalanx: 3% compensation of the Benefit Limit
- Loss by physical severance or Permanent Disablement of any other toe: 3% compensation of the Benefit Limit

We will not pay for any Permanent Disablement that is not listed in the scale of compensation above.

results.heading: Section 12. Cash Relief for Death Due to Accident
results.snippet: We will pay the Benefit Limit in the event that You suffer death due to Bodily Injury or Sickness sustained while Overseas during the Trip.

results.heading: Section 25. Flight Overbooked
results.snippet:
In the event that You are denied from boarding a confirmed scheduled Flight as indicated on the travel ticket due to over-booking and no alternative transportation is made available to You for at least six (6) consecutive hours of the boarding time indicated on the travel ticket, We shall pay You $100 for each continuous six (6) hour period, up to the Benefit Limit.

You must obtain and provide to Us a written verification from the operator(s) of the Common Carrier or their handling agent(s), stating that You were denied from boarding a confirmed scheduled Flight due to over-booking.

results.heading: HDFC Retail Collections — Benefits
results.snippet:
HDFC Retail Collections — caller benefits summary (agent reference)

- Clear dues by the statement due date to avoid late fees where applicable.
- Set a promise-to-pay with a concrete date when you need a few more days.
- Request a hardship-review callback if you face job loss or medical emergency.
- Update auto-debit mandates after an EMI bounce to reduce repeat failures.
- After full clearance, request NOC / account-closure documentation through
  the normal fulfilment process (not same-day guaranteed on the call).
- Speak only to the verified account holder; third parties cannot receive
  balance details.

results.heading: Can you waive the late fee?
results.snippet: Late-fee waivers need supervisor review. I can log your request and arrange a specialist callback — I cannot approve a waiver on this call.

results.heading: Hardship
results.snippet:
If the customer discloses financial hardship (job loss, medical emergency),
acknowledge empathetically, offer a callback for hardship review, and escalate
when distress is severe. Do not pressure for immediate full payment.

results.heading: When will I get an NOC after clearing my dues?
results.snippet: An NOC or account-closure letter is issued only after the outstanding balance is cleared and internal checks finish. Same-day issuance is not guaranteed.
